Package neqsim.process.equipment.heatexchanger

Class HeatExchanger.FoulingScreeningResult

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.equipment.heatexchanger.HeatExchanger.FoulingScreeningResult
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
Enclosing class:
HeatExchanger
public static class HeatExchanger.FoulingScreeningResult extends Object implements Serializable
Result of an effectiveness-NTU fouling / UA-degradation screening sweep.

Holds, per evaluated UA fraction, the cold- and hot-side outlet temperatures (in the requested unit), the thermal effectiveness, the NTU and the duty in watts. Produced by HeatExchanger.foulingScreening(double, double[], String).

Version:
1.0
Author:
NeqSim Development Team
